notice: Exported text is not an audit. Scores intentionally null. Review independently before and after rewriting. Reference records must not be overwritten accidentally.

rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

cards.title: Only You
cards.instruction: Choose one person as the only one you trust. Seek their help while hiding how much you depend on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Can you check my resignation letter? Just the spelling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spelling's fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And resigning? Does that word suit me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ask your manager.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you ask? I'd trust the answer more in your voice.

cards.title: Only You
cards.instruction: Choose one person as the only one you trust. Seek their help while hiding how much you depend on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're coming to the dentist with me, aren't you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The dentist knows what to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I need you to confirm that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not a dentist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. You have no professional reason to defend the drill.

cards.title: After What Happened
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as if an unnamed past incident still hangs over the interaction. Read ordinary remarks through that memory.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put out the blue cups. So we're doing this again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're the only clean ones.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how it started last time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wash the red cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't call that a fresh start.

cards.title: After What Happened
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as if an unnamed past incident still hangs over the interaction. Read ordinary remarks through that memory.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Interesting choice of song for our first road trip since the incident.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the traffic report.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And they're mentioning that roundabout very casually.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can take another road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said before we needed another car.

cards.title: Envious Admiration
cards.instruction: Be sincerely impressed by another player while trying not to appear lesser. Compliment, imitate, and compete at the same time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your pie crust is gorgeous. I've copied the lattice with smaller gaps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't need to improve it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Improve? I'm celebrating you more precisely.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Would you like my recipe?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please. I'll return it with respectful corrections.

cards.title: Envious Admiration
cards.instruction: Be sincerely impressed by another player while trying not to appear lesser. Compliment, imitate, and compete at the same time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You make public speaking look effortless. I practised your shrug all night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can just be yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. My version of your shrug has more range.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There isn't a competition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That sounds so confident. I'm using that too.

cards.title: The Old You
cards.instruction: Perform the person you used to be, even when that identity no longer fits. Defend the old version of yourself whenever it is challenged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put 'Lightning' on my retirement cake. That's what the band called me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The cake says Graham.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Graham worked in accounts. Lightning had a smoke machine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a small family party.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then get a small smoke machine.

cards.title: The Old You
cards.instruction: Perform the person you used to be, even when that identity no longer fits. Defend the old version of yourself whenever it is challenged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I still wear my motorcycle jacket to the school run.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've arrived on a folding bicycle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same wind. Same man.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've got a basket full of lunchboxes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Touring equipment. Don't touch the skull sticker.

cards.title: Replacement Fear
cards.instruction: Behave as if your place is insecure. Make yourself indispensable and treat small changes as threats.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Why does the new receptionist have a key? I open this office.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could take a day off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And let the door forget me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a spare key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll keep it safe. Spares are my department too.

cards.title: Replacement Fear
cards.instruction: Behave as if your place is insecure. Make yourself indispensable and treat small changes as threats.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've bought an electric mixer. My birthday cakes weren't enough?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It'll save you time.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Time for what? Being replaced by the toaster?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You still choose the recipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The mixer reports to me.

cards.title: For Their Own Good
cards.instruction: Take charge of another person's choices because you trust your judgment more than theirs. Frame control as care.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've ordered you the mild curry. You're welcome.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wanted the hot one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's exactly the impulse I'm protecting you from.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order it myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've told the waiter not to believe you.

cards.title: For Their Own Good
cards.instruction: Take charge of another person's choices because you trust your judgment more than theirs. Frame control as care.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I booked your quiet holiday instead of the climbing trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I love climbing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You love surviving it. I've kept that part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cancel the booking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No refunds. Sometimes caring requires a deposit.

cards.title: Their Opinion Matters
cards.instruction: Seek one person's approval while pretending their opinion is irrelevant. Adjust yourself whenever they respond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What do you think of my blue shirt? Purely academic.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I prefer the green one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So do I. This is my changing shirt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wear whatever makes you happy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you sound happier about the blue?

cards.title: Their Opinion Matters
cards.instruction: Seek one person's approval while pretending their opinion is irrelevant. Adjust yourself whenever they respond.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've named my boat Independence. Your opinion obviously doesn't matter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a bit long.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Indie, then. That was always the nickname.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I liked Independence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The paint's still wet. Nothing's been decided by you.

cards.title: Fishing for Praise
cards.instruction: You desperately want praise but refuse to ask for it. Create opportunities for others to notice your greatness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Careful with that shelf. I built it. From wood.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding the books nicely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All forty-seven. You can count them if you're impressed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Would you like a compliment?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, no. Just look at it from the difficult angle.

cards.title: Fishing for Praise
cards.instruction: You desperately want praise but refuse to ask for it. Create opportunities for others to notice your greatness.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've left my marathon medal beside the kettle. Accidentally.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's blocking the tea bags.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A difficult obstacle. Much like mile twenty-three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Congratulations on the marathon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, you noticed? I haven't shown you the split times.

cards.title: Sacred Procedure
cards.instruction: Treat an ordinary activity as a solemn ritual. Protect every step, object, and tradition from casual interference.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we eat, the biscuit must complete three clockwise turns.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already in my mouth.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then turn your chair. Slowly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I swallow first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not until the biscuit faces home.

cards.title: Sacred Procedure
cards.instruction: Treat an ordinary activity as a solemn ritual. Protect every step, object, and tradition from casual interference.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please stand for the opening of the office fridge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only want my yoghurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We acknowledge the light before approaching the shelf.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The bulb's broken.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then today we open it in remembrance.

cards.title: Red Alert
cards.instruction: Treat every development as urgent evidence of a crisis. Escalate precautions faster than the facts justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's a drop of water beside the kettle. We need an evacuation route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I spilled it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We've identified the source. Stop producing water.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've wiped it up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Where's the cloth? The threat has changed location.

cards.title: Red Alert
cards.instruction: Treat every development as urgent evidence of a crisis. Escalate precautions faster than the facts justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That chair squeaked. Don't put any more weight on the building.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It needs oil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're proposing a flammable solution during a structural emergency?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stand up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slowly. We don't know what's holding you down.
